runtime: Packaged Prism Launcher client on AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX
shader_pipeline: Iris selected BSL and created the minecraft:overworld pipeline
world: Fresh disposable world with commands enabled
visual_verdict: The Ghost is clear and recognizable indoors, by day, at night, and in rain; daylight makes it very bright but does not erase its face. The Wraith is recognizable indoors, by day, and in rain. Its face and separated arms remain visible at night, though the model is dim and low contrast in that scene.
capture_note: The external X11 surface stopped refreshing during gameplay, so the evidence uses Minecraft F2 screenshots read from the current post-shader framebuffer.
